$comment: Machine-readable manifest of repo dev tasks. The runner is ./skills.sh (run `./skills.sh <name>`). Keep names in sync with skills.sh; see SKILLS.md.

skills.name: lint
skills.description: Clippy across the workspace with warnings denied, then the feature-off binary.
skills.command: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p rift --no-default-features --all-targets -- -D warnings

skills.name: test
skills.description: Run the full workspace test suite.

skills.name: build
skills.description: Debug build of the whole workspace.

skills.name: release
skills.description: Optimized release build (matches CI's final step).

skills.name: check
skills.command: skills.sh fmt-check && skills.sh lint && skills.sh test

skills.name: run
skills.description: Run the rift binary; forwards trailing args (e.g. `run -- status`).

skills.name: memd
skills.description: Run the rift-memd recall binary; forwards trailing args (e.g. `memd -- status`).

skills.name: smoke
skills.description: Quick smoke: rift and rift-memd report status.
skills.command: cargo run -q -p rift -- status && cargo run -q -p rift-memd -- status

skills.name: coverage
skills.description: Instrumented run plus the per-crate >=95% line gate. Requires the nightly toolchain: --branch passes -Z coverage-options=branch, which the pinned 1.96.0 stable channel refuses, and check-coverage fails closed without branch data.
skills.command: cargo +nightly llvm-cov clean --workspace && cargo +nightly llvm-cov --workspace --all-features --branch --no-report && cargo +nightly llvm-cov report --json --output-path cov.json --ignore-filename-regex 'keychain_os\.rs' && cargo run -p xtask -- check-coverage cov.json

skills.name: docs
skills.description: Build rustdoc for the workspace with warnings denied (the CI docs job's exact command).

skills.name: gc
skills.description: Stop detached workers and prune nested vogon-e2e sub-targets, stale incremental caches, and orphaned ~/.cargo-targets directories.
